description: r0b0tlab's frozen native-v11 dual-GB10 runtime (vLLM 0.26.0+dspark.sm121.3, NCCL 2.30.4, FlashInfer B12X MoE, NVFP4 DS-MLA KV, DSpark K=6, native regular CUDA graphs) for the official DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 checkpoint at 9e165c30. Text only. Upstream production defaults: 327,680 token context, 16 sequences, KV pool pinned at about 15 GiB (roughly 156k tokens); the repository's 1M-context profile (auto-sized KV, one sequence) is not selectable here. Licences: recipe and runtime MIT AND Apache-2.0, model MIT (information only). Vonk physical dual-Spark acceptance is pending; performance figures are upstream claims.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 DSpark vLLM 0.26 dual Spark (r0b0tlab)
